text.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Splash About
attacks.text: If Buizel has less Energy attached to it than the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

text.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Floatzel but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

text.flavor: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

text.name: Goldeen
text.flavor: It swims elegantly by fluttering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

text.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

text.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

text.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Aqua Shower
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Brine
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

text.name: Seaking

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Seaking.

text.flavor: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

text.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Shining Fang
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

text.name: Dusk Ball
effect: Look at the 7 cards from the bottom of your deck. Choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Energy Search
effect: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Potion
effect: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).
